text: DF Industrie is a SASU (single-shareholder company) whose sole shareholder and president is DF Invest, a privately held Le Havre SAS chaired by David Folliot; the registry names no state or state-fund shareholder.
short: DF Industrie is wholly owned by private holding DF Invest (president David Folliot).
